serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Beam is a browser-based SaaS platform for human services agencies. Notes records staff conversations and produces an AI transcript and summary against customer-defined templates; a human reviews, edits, and copies the output into the customer's case management system; Reports, a function within Notes, summarizes uploaded documents, recordings, handwritten notes, video, or existing Notes into a report against a customer template. Talk is a conversational AI voice and chat agent that answers resident calls and chats, with SIP transfer to a human agent on triage need, safeguarding risk, or explicit request. Interpret provides real-time interpretation, combining speech-to-text, LLM interpretation, and text-to-speech, through a browser interface or over a telephone path. The US deployment is standalone: customer data is stored and processed entirely within the continental United States, in US data centers, with backups stored in US data centers.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Beam's Trust Center: certifications and attestations (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II with HIPAA attestation, CSA STAR Level 1), security policies, penetration test attestation, sub-processor list, and knowledge base.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: The landing page at https://trust.beam.org is publicly accessible. Document access requires an access request via the Get Access link; requests are reviewed by Beam's Trust & Safety team. The SOC 2 Type II report is released under NDA to a named reviewer.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Browser-based recording of staff conversations with AI transcription and AI summarization against customer-defined templates. A human reviews and edits all output before it enters the customer's system of record. Includes Reports, a function within Notes that summarizes uploaded documents, recordings, handwritten notes, video, or existing Notes into a report against a customer template.
Conversational AI voice and chat agent answering resident calls and chats, with SIP transfer to a human agent on triage need, safeguarding risk, or explicit request.

Real-time interpretation combining speech-to-text, LLM interpretation, and text-to-speech, delivered through a browser interface or over a telephone path in which a call is set up between two phone numbers and a recorded consent message is played in the client's language.

certified.useCase: OpenAI API Platform: primary summarization (GPT-4o / GPT-4.1) via the dedicated gov.api.openai.com endpoint.

Google Cloud Platform (US regions): primary application hosting on Cloud Run, Cloud SQL PostgreSQL database (us-central1), object storage, and Redis cache; Gemini models via Google Cloud (us-central1) for summarization.
AWS US East/West: fallback summarization via AWS Bedrock (us-west-2) and supporting services in US regions.

Microsoft Azure Commercial (US regions), fallback only: Azure-hosted OpenAI models on US endpoints for transcription fallback, and Azure Speech (Central US) as the final transcription fallback for Talk.
